author: Paperwite
body:
My Ign is Paperwite. I was banned for about half a year now, I really want to come back to the server and become a part of the great community. I think I have applied for 2 times and this time will be my third. I believe I should be unbanned because I have tried many times to get unbanned, I think by my 3rd appeal I should be unbanned because I have learned my lesson. I was banned for multiple infractions. Over half of them in 2014 which is about 2 years ago. And a few in 2015 It's pretty much a new year and I want to have a fresh start. I wish to spend the new year with joy, I really think I have learned my lesson and I think I should be unbanned. I believe that everyone can start over and have a new start, I wish to be granted another chance.

-Sincerely, Paperwite

Hello Paperwite,

Regards
